title: 2019-05-10 MoM Cloud governance - Account handling

Goals

Discussion items

TimeItemWhoNotes

Introductions of meeting participants and of IPEX Name

Peter Jönsson started at CBF 1st of May. Have previously worked as infrastructure responsible at INGKA. Will work with Joakim Mårtensson with both cloud and on prem infrastructure.

Discussion of the need of a small but concrete way of handling Azure accounts and subscriptions. Peter informed about new page for ordering a subscription, https://interikea.service-now.com/help?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=35efb70cdbafef40b905789e3b96191e&sysparm_category=e2716cafdba06380f589d3ca4b9619fa


What is the next steps of defining CBF strategy for handling accounts on Azure?

Peter discuss with Martin Persson next week regarding creation of Cloudyn report as first step for IPEX to have an updated view of used accounts.

Discuss with Digital Architecture regarding how to handle administration of accounts i.e. should we follow recommendations in the defined in Azure Operational Governance Framework where IPEX can be considered a department.

Goal is to have a one page description of the core governance rules. Description and management of account types. Recommendations for usage of accounts and responsibilities.
